description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeEvaluationAPI class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin, specifically for handling employee evaluation endpoints. It includes methods for retrieving and updating performance review evaluations, managing permissions, and handling review states, with extensive use of OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeEvaluationAPI
classes.description: API class for handling employee evaluation performance reviews, including retrieving evaluation data, managing review states, permissions, and updating review ratings and comments within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviewer ratings and evaluation data for an employee's review, including permissions and allowed actions, with support for sorting, pagination, and conditional rating data based on user role.

methods.name: getReviewerRatings
methods.description: Fetches reviewer ratings for a specific evaluation filter and reviewer group.

methods.name: getReviewerRatingCount
methods.description: Counts the number of reviewer ratings for a specific evaluation filter and reviewer group.

methods.name: getReviewerForReviewRating
methods.description: Gets normalized reviewer data for a specific review id, used in review rating responses.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Returns permissible actions for a given performance review based on its current state and user role.

methods.name: getAllowedActionList
methods.description: Determines allowed workflow actions for the current review state, excluding roles like 'ESS' when viewed by others.

methods.name: setReviewRatingsParams
methods.description: Saves and updates review ratings submitted in the request for a specific review.

methods.name: checkActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether current user is permitted to perform actions that transition the review to in-progress or completed states.

methods.name: updateReviewerStatus
methods.description: Updates reviewer's status to in-progress or completed based on the request parameter.

methods.name: updateReviewerComment
methods.description: Updates the reviewer comment for a review if provided.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating review evaluation data, extending parent rules with additional 'complete' boolean validation.
